create.name: Jennifer Partridge
create.bio:
Jennifer Partridge is an Australian-born teacher of EFT tapping, also trained in yoga, who describes herself as a spiritual guide. After years of study in monasteries, ashrams and villages across India, Nepal, Thailand, Indonesia and South America, and training in Reiki, NLP, Kundalini and Ashtanga yoga, she developed her own style, Dream Awake Tapping, which joins the tapping points of EFT with breath, somatic movement and spoken intention. She lived in the United States for sixteen years and now spends most of her time in Tulum, Mexico.

Her teaching centres on self-worth, intuition, letting go of old patterns and shaping a life that feels purposeful. She leads long live tapping sessions and masterclasses on her YouTube channel, runs a certification for tapping coaches whose graduates are listed on her site, and has taught at festivals such as Wanderlust, Bhakti Fest and Lightning in a Bottle. Her book Dream Awake, published in 2011, led to a speaking tour of Colombia opening for don Miguel Ruiz, and she has interviewed teachers including Deepak Chopra and Michael Beckwith. On Commune she introduces EFT through five short daily sessions.

courses.title: Dream Awake Tapping Coach Certification
courses.description: A six-month training in Jennifer's Dream Awake style of EFT tapping for people who want to guide others professionally. New rounds open from a waitlist; graduates can join the list of Dream Awake coaches on her site.

free_resources.title: Tapping Basics: Free 5-Part Video Course
free_resources.description: A free five-part video course explaining what EFT tapping is and where the points are, with a downloadable chart. It ends with two guided sessions, on clearing fear and on saying yes to change, each with a worksheet.

free_resources.title: Dream Awake TV
free_resources.description: Jennifer's free library of recorded tapping sessions, short talks and interviews, arranged in collections by theme. Viewers can also suggest topics for future sessions.

flags: Health rule, borderline teacher: her own site leans on her recovery story (abuse, PTSD, addiction, autoimmune illness) and some sales copy claims EFT transforms anxiety and depression and clears trauma. Her current YouTube titles are mostly about self-worth, intuition, abundance and letting go, so a page was made from those; a human may still judge her work too condition-framed and skip her.

Commune course 'Tap into Healing' (Practice category, $49 USD) is left out: its copy frames the course around processing trauma and 'stepping out of pain' and includes a 'Healing Our Pain' deep dive. teaches_at commune is kept.
Thin page apart from videos: 1 offering (coach certification, waitlist only) and 2 free resources; her book Dream Awake could not be verified on Amazon (see left_out).
Email is a support inbox (support@jenniferpartridge.com), published on her Press & Media page for interview requests.
Tier just under the 80k flag band (~77k).
Photo 1 is her headshot from the Commune course page; photo 2 is from her own site (same person). Her YouTube avatar (a swimwear beach shot) was not used.
Availability set to worldwide: she says she travels and lives mostly in Tulum, Mexico, with no stated place where she sees people.
left_out: Tap into Healing (Commune): trauma and pain framing.
Personal Peace Process (7-week programme): sales copy names abuse, chronic disease and addiction; enrolment also shown as closed.
Dream Awake Live in Sydney (27 Mar 2026): past, and its copy claims EFT treats anxiety and depression.
Tapping Coach Certification round starting 1 Feb 2026: past (the waitlist page is listed instead).
Book Dream Awake (ASIN 0989355543, linked from her store): amazon.com /dp/ page returned 500 by curl and WebFetch, so not verified; left out.
Tapping Journal: no product page or Amazon listing found.

Videos 'Healing the Mother Father Wound with EFT Tapping', 'Heal Deep Emotions with EFT Tapping', 'Why your healing breakthrough didn't last', business/wealth-for-coaches sessions and recruiting videos ('Should you become a Tapping Coach?'): borderline wound framing, shorter than 2 minutes, or sales.
Book a Coach page: lists other coaches' sessions, not hers.
